correctness.rationale: Conditional stationary Gaussian variances are positive exponential functionals. Poisson/Brownian independent-increment decomposition rigorously gives moment cutoffs at the unique positive Cramer exponent, including divergence at equality. Exact generator recursions give the finite-index ratio. Uniform signed binomial remainder and sum of (2j-1)(2j-2)/6 prove the explicit cubic log-relative-error coefficient for any m increasing with ms tending to zero. Positive-function argument proves the strict ordering of critical moment scales. The 110659 finite assertions complement but do not replace proof.

value.rationale: The controlled low-shock diffusion approximation is motivated by stochastic catastrophes in statistical physics. The result quantifies precisely when a model matching stationary variance exactly ceases to reproduce increasingly rare fluctuations: the relative-moment breakdown has a sharp \(s^{-2/3}\) scale whereas existence changes on the later \(s^{-1}\) scale. The mechanism, exact constants and parameter window distinguish two natural and practically consequential notions of approximation accuracy.
